Row.Text: Do you want to deactivate all tutorials? You can reactivate them later on the Options Menu

A [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] is suffering from an Outbreak. Outbreaks cause [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_UNREST_TOOLTIP]Unrest[/TIP], pillage [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_BUILDINGS_TOOLTIP]Buildings[/TIP] and [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_IMPROVEMENT_TOOLTIP]Improvements[/TIP] and damage Units in the affected tiles. While a Settlement is [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_INFECTED_TOOLTIP]Infected[/TIP], it cannot [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_POPULATION_TOOLTIP]Grow[/TIP] and will create Migrants instead.[n]Major Outbreaks can spread and cause Minor Outbreaks in [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CONNECTED_TOOLTIP]Connected Settlements[/TIP].[n]Outbreaks are more likely to occur in Settlements that are densely populated, Connected to road and [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TRADE_NETWORK_TOOLTIP]Trade Networks[/TIP] or under siege.

The [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] of [b]{1_CityName}[/b] is so unhappy they are considering Revolt. If they remain Unhappy they may petition to join another Civilization.[n]Consider changing your Policies or moving [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RESOURCES_TOOLTIP]Resources[/TIP] to this Settlement to improve their [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b]. If all else fails, Stationing a [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_COMMANDER_TOOLTIP]Commander[/TIP] here will help reduce the Unhappiness as well.

You may now research [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SYNCRETISM_TOOLTIP]Syncretism[/TIP], a powerful tool for Time-Tested Civilizations. [n]Syncretism allows you to study other Civilizations currently in their [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_APEX_AGE_TOOLTIP]Apex Age[/TIP] and adopt their [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_UNIQUE_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Unique Units[/TIP] or infrastructure for the remainder of this Age; you can also choose a strategically complimentary [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TRADITION_TOOLTIP]Tradition[/TIP] to affirm your Time-Tested identity.

Welcome to the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SYNCRETISM_TOOLTIP]Syncretism[/TIP] Screen. Here you will choose what to adopt from [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_APEX_AGE_TOOLTIP]Apex Age[/TIP] Civilizations based on your current Civilization and Leader; you can also choose to affirm your own Civilization with a strategically complimentary [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TRADITION_TOOLTIP]Tradition[/TIP]. [n]Once you choose what to syncretize, it cannot be changed!

When this [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_AGE_TOOLTIP]Age[/TIP] ends, you will be faced with a choice: stay as this Civilization and become Time-Tested, or pick a new Civilization that will be entering their Apex. [n]For now, explore what this Civilization has to offer; it will help you decide whether to transition to a new Civilization or stand the test of time.
This is the final [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_AGE_TOOLTIP]Age[/TIP], utilize your Civilization's ability to claim Victory!
When this [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_AGE_TOOLTIP]Age[/TIP] ends, you will be able to stay as your current Civilization, or pick a different Civilization entering its Apex Age.
While your Apex Age has passed, your people are ready to claim Victory!
